ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.PARA_1: I am a dedicated Senior Front-End Developer based in {{location}}, India, with over {{years}} years of professional experience in crafting scalable, enterprise-grade web applications. My journey in software engineering began with a B.Tech from JNTU Kakinada, and has evolved into a deep specialization in the Angular ecosystem.
ABOUT.PARA_2: Currently, at Cognizant Technology Services, I am driving innovation in Big Data Analytics. I architect comprehensive workflow engines and engineer high-performance visualization tools to render complex signal data from Parquet files into interactive, real-time line charts.
ABOUT.PARA_3: I am a strong advocate for modern engineering standards, utilizing NX Monorepos for architectural scalability and ensuring uncompromising code quality through SonarQube and advanced testing suites like Vitest and Jest. My goal is to continuously push the boundaries of what's possible on the web by blending performance-driven engineering with intuitive UI/UX design.
